# vintage_net_mobile v0.12.0 - Table of Contents

> Mobile connection support for VintageNet

## Pages

- [VintageNetMobile](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [VintageNetMobile](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.md): Use cellular modems with VintageNet
- [VintageNetMobile.ASUCalculator](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.ASUCalculator.md): Convert raw ASU values to friendlier units
- [VintageNetMobile.CellMonitor](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.CellMonitor.md): Monitor cell network information
- [VintageNetMobile.ExChat](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.ExChat.md): Send commands to your modem and get notifications
- [VintageNetMobile.Modem](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.md): A behaviour for modem implementations

- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.Automatic](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.Automatic.md): Modem for automatic detection and configuration of USB-based modems
- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.HuaweiE3372](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.HuaweiE3372.md): Huawei E3372 support
- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.HuaweiE3372.Modeswitch](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.HuaweiE3372.Modeswitch.md): VintageNetMobile PowerManager to handle the HuaweiE3372 modem

- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.QuectelBG96](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.QuectelBG96.md): Quectel BG96 support
- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.QuectelEC25](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.QuectelEC25.md): Quectel EC25 support
- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.SierraHL8548](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.SierraHL8548.md): Sierra Wireless HL8548 modem
- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.TelitLE910](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.TelitLE910.md): Telit LE910 support
- [VintageNetMobile.Modem.UbloxTOBYL2](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.Modem.UbloxTOBYL2.md): # u-blox TOBY-L2 support
- [VintageNetMobile.ModemInfo](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.ModemInfo.md): Query the modem for device and SIM information
- [VintageNetMobile.SignalMonitor](https://vintage-net-mobile.hexdocs.pm/VintageNetMobile.SignalMonitor.md): Monitor the cell signal levels
